notes: s015 'because of' is treated as one contiguous prepositional expression on the Greek preposition, headed on 'because'; heading it on 'of' is not defensible since 'because' is the word realizing dia.
The intensifying καί is aligned to 'also' under rule 65's English-side test.
'Διὰ τί' -> 'Why' analysed as in 15:2, which is rule 24's habit.
